950.note: 1 CPU: two 250 W double-wide cards; 2 CPUs: two 150 W single-wide only
two 6+2-pin; 250 W per slot when two high-power cards

Dell Precision 5820.dual_slots: slots 2 and 4 (CPU x16 Gen3); a double-wide card in slot 2 covers slot 3 - the cards sit adjacent
Dell Precision 5820.max_gpu_note: VERIFIED: full length 12.28 in / 312 mm (Technical Guidebook p.23)

750.note: 2x 6-pin: an 8-pin card needs an adapter HP does not list

1000.note: 4x 6+2-pin; needs HP Fan and Front Card Guide Kit for dual high-end

HP Z4 G4.kit_note: HP requires the Fan and Front Card Guide Kit (1MY89AV / 1XM33AA) for an RTX A4000-class card
HP Z4 G4.max_gpu_note: INFERRED: HP lists slots 1-5 as full-height full-length (with extender); full length = 312 mm
HP Z4 G4.m2: 2 onboard M.2 Gen3 x4 slots from the CPU (QuickSpecs c05527757)

1000.note: 2x 6-pin convertible to 8-pin; the only PSU option

HP Z6 G4.m2: M.2 on board (slot 4 drops to x4 when the second M.2 is used, QuickSpecs)

690.note: CPU <=140 W: one card <=265 W + one <=180 W

Lenovo ThinkStation P520.max_gpu_note: INFERRED: Lenovo lists slots 2/4 as 'full height, full length'; a full-length PCIe card is <= 312 mm (PCIe CEM)
Lenovo ThinkStation P520.m2: 2 onboard M.2 PCIe NVMe slots ('M.2 Slots: 2 via onboard slots', PSREF Dec 2023 p.3)

benchmarks._about: tg/pp = tokens/s. MEASURED values link their source; ESTIMATED values show the formula. llama.cpp latest b11946 (2026-10-28).

pcie_width.finding: Layer split decode barely depends on link width: x8 vs x1 -5% (5060 Ti), ~x2 eGPU -2% (3060), AMD chipset x4 -3.5% (ROCm). No dual-3060 x4-vs-x8 measurement exists; tensor-split sensitivity UNVERIFIED.
pcie_width.label: MEASURED (proxies)

cpu_offload_estimates.formula: tg_max = 0.65 x RAM bandwidth / active expert bytes per token
cpu_offload_estimates.label: ESTIMATED
cpu_offload_estimates.note: no measured Xeon W-2100/2200 quad-channel offload run was found; CPU compute (4-6 cores) may cap it

speculative.finding: Draft model (Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B) on 3090 + Coder-32B: 34.8 -> 51.3 tg (1.47x). MTP (merged 2026-05-16, PR #22673) on 3x3060 27B: 18.5 -> 32.2 (1.74x). No gain when experts sit in system RAM.
speculative.label: MEASURED

software.llama_cpp: sm_120 (5060 Ti) built only with CUDA >= 12.8; Ubuntu release binaries ship CUDA 12.8 and 13.4
software.linux_note: multi-GPU layer split on Windows/WDDM measured ~half the decode speed of Ubuntu on the same hardware (discussion #28767) - use Ubuntu

fit_estimates.14B Q4 + 32k ctx: 16.3 GB f16 KV (13.1 GB with q8_0 KV): no on 12 GB, yes on 16 GB with q8 KV
fit_estimates.30B-A3B MoE Q4 + 8k: 20.1 GB: 24 GB or 2x12 fully on GPU; on 12/16 GB use --n-cpu-moe
fit_estimates.label: ESTIMATED

tax_basis: Florida Rule 12A-1.045(3): shipping on ship-only listings is taxable; 6% state + 1% Miami-Dade surtax
